restoration_note: Teaching describes the Apostle's salutation as ultimate-form of cosmic letters between Living Spirit and the molded man: Calling↔Hearing pair, then First Man's ascent as answering letter, then Mind of Light from Christ. Apparatus restorations are firmly constrained by formula-parallels (lines 2-3 ↔ lines 14-15) and by lexicon terms (ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ, ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ, ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲡⲡⲛ̄ⲁ̄ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲥ̄, ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ, ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲁ, ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ). Two small unrestorable gaps ({22} 1-char particle and {24} 2-char fragment after isolated ⲧ) lack constraint. {12} filled with ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉϥ "heard it" because the Calling/Hearing pair governs and the est_chars=6 matches; {21} and {23} restored with ascent/sending vocabulary fitting the second-letter motion upward from molded man to Living Spirit.

restorations.basis: Lyc. ⲭⲉ = ϫⲉ quotative complementizer; single-letter restoration confirmed by apparatus and the question that follows in line 4.
ⲡⲧ[ⲱϩ]ⲙⲉ completes ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ 'the Call' (lexicon: established term for the Calling); confirmed by ⲙⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ pair on next line.
Final letter completing ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ from prior line; standard Call/Hearing word-pair.
ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ[ϩ ⲁ]ⲃⲁⲗ 'sent forth' — completes the standard send-forth verb-phrase (lexicon: ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ for influx); ⲃⲁⲗ visible at start of line 5.
ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'molding of man' (lexicon: the natural man as molded / proprium being formed); confirmed by ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ visible at start of line 6.
ⲁⲥⲡⲁⲥ[ⲙⲟⲥ] = Greek ἀσπασμός 'greeting' — standard epistolary collocation with ⲉⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ.
[ⲧ]ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ relative converter; single-letter restoration before ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ.
ⲛ̄[ⲁⲅⲅⲉ]ⲗⲓⲁ = ἀγγελία 'tidings, message'; confirmed by ⲗⲓⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ at start of line 8 — fits the formula 'in which all the tidings are written.'
[ϣⲱⲡ]ⲉ continues ⲉⲧⲛⲁ-ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'shall happen' from line 8 end; standard formula 'everything that shall happen.'
[ⲉⲧⲙ̄]ⲙⲉⲩ standard demonstrative 'there/that' — fits with ⲡⲓ̈ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ.
Beginning of demonstrative ⲡⲓⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ 'this Call' continuing into line 10.
[ⲧⲱ]ϩⲙⲉ — completes ⲡⲓⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ from line 9 across line break.

est_chars=6 matches ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉϥ exactly. The Call/Hearing pair governs the whole chapter (lexicon: ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ = receptive response to Divine Truth); the molded man as recipient of the Calling 'hears it.' ⲛ̄ⲧⲁ ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ + verb requires direct-object suffix construction.
ⲥϩⲛⲏⲩⲧ qualitative of ⲥϩⲁⲓ 'be written' (cf. ⲥⲏϩ in lines 8 and 16); preceding character lost; matches the formula 'in which X stands written.'
ⲧⲟⲩ[ⲱϣⲃ] = ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃ 'the Answer' opens the second letter section; ⲁⲩⲭⲁⲩϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they set forth' parallels ⲁϩⲭⲁⲩϩ in line 3 — symmetric Call/Answer formula.
[ⲙⲡ]ϣⲁⲣⲡⲧ — preposition + 'first' completing ⲙ̄ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'from the First Man' (lexicon: established cosmological entity, Divine Truth descending).

restorations.proposed_english: t up to the Living Spirit
restorations.basis: ⲁⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ 'to the Height' + ϣⲁ ⲡⲡⲛ̄ⲁ̄ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲥ̄ 'unto the Living Spirit' — mirrors line 3 (Calling sent FROM Living Spirit) with ascent direction reversed; lexicon-confirmed cosmological vocabulary for the second letter.
[ⲟ]ⲩⲉⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ — indefinite article + ἐπιστολή 'letter'; single-letter restoration.
Standard relative-perfect 'which they sent forth from' parallel to line 2-3 send-formula; required by ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ at start of line 15 (the second letter goes FROM the molded man).
Standard formula 'in which all the tidings... are written down' parallels lines 7-8 of the first letter; relative converter + ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲁ confirmed by ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲏϩ at start of line 16.
ⲛ̄ⲡⲟ[ⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ] 'all the wars' (lexicon: ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ = wars and salvations / cosmic conflicts); confirmed by ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ in line 21 and ⲙ̄ⲁ̄ⲟⲟϩ 'strifes' in line 17.

ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲥⲧⲁ[ⲩⲁⲩ ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈] — relative perfect of ⲥⲧⲁ 'turn/return' with reflexive + ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'upward' (lexicon: ascend = ⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈, the soul's return home). Fits the spiritual arc of the second letter carrying upward the record of the molded man's return; est_chars=9 with one trace.
Single-character gap with no traces and no formula constraint; could be a final letter from preceding word in line 17 or a particle (ⲛ̄, ⲉ, ⲁ) before ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃ. Honest non-restoration is preferable.

est_chars=7 matches ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩϥ̄ 'sent it.' The molded man writes/sends the Answer to the Living Spirit (lexicon: ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ = send forth / influx). Parallels the send-forth formula governing both letters; fits the second-letter motion upward.
Two-character gap after isolated ⲧ with both chars marked as uncertain traces ('. .'); could be ⲧ[ⲏⲣ] (broken across line, missing ⲟⲩ) or ⲧ[ⲁⲓ̈]; no formula sufficient to discriminate. Unrestorable.
Standard pair 'everything that has happened and everything that shall happen' confirmed by ⲉⲁϩϣⲱⲡⲉ in same line; same formula appears in line 8.
[ⲡ]ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲓ̈ⲧϩ definite-article restoration before relative substantive 'that which has come.'
ⲧ[ⲏⲣⲟ]ⲩ 'all' — middle letters of ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ modifying ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ 'all the wars.'
